changeSet.author: paypulse
changeSet.comment: source_event_id semantics change from event_store CDC numeric id to application-level UUID. Old rows are no longer addressable; wipe before type change.

changeSet.author: paypulse
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE account_query.balance_events ALTER COLUMN source_event_id TYPE VARCHAR(64) USING source_event_id::varchar
ALTER TABLE account_query.account_balance ALTER COLUMN last_source_event_id TYPE VARCHAR(64) USING last_source_event_id::varchar

changeSet.author: paypulse
changeSet.comment: event_store is insert-only and streamed by Debezium via the EventRouter (payment.events). INSERT-only CDC needs only the primary key in WAL, so REPLICA IDENTITY DEFAULT is sufficient and keeps WAL volume low (FULL is only required for UPDATE/DELETE CDC).
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE payment_command.event_store REPLICA IDENTITY DEFAULT
